summary: The base reproduced the third-flush IndexError and pre-crash trace mislabeling. The exact candidate bound each flush to its actual ShapeKey and produced 16 collision-free, correctly attributed real GPU traces across batch, LoRA, attention/DSA-like, and stream variants.

tests.what_was_measured: Genuine ROCm CUDA-graph/profiler callback reproduction; failed on the third flush with IndexError after writing two traces, including one misattributed filename.
Candidate regression coverage for exact ShapeKey enqueueing, optional identity fields, unique filenames, profiler scheduling, and backend integration; 18 passed.
16 real GPU graph captures/replays across 2 batch sizes x 2 stream IDs x 2 LoRA states x 2 attention variants; 16 unique traces and max absolute replay error 0.0.
Independent parsing of all 16 Chrome traces, matching filename identities to exact ProfilerStep order and requiring kernel events.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2.26015, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; real torch.cuda.CUDAGraph capture/replay and profiler traces were executed.

remaining_limitations: The full amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 TP=8 server/model was not run; the same callback path was exercised with minimal genuine GPU graphs.
Production PDMUX is NVIDIA-only; multiple stream groups were represented by separate profiler contexts and ShapeKey stream IDs on ROCm, not run through the NVIDIA PDMUX implementation.
The available GPU was MI350X rather than the reporter's MI355X.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changed no native source.
